messages:
rachel: Weekly account health check for OrbitPay onboarding — saw error spike in last 90m. 5xx 3.1% (+1.3ppt), timeouts 1.1% (+0.5ppt), 429s 0.9% (+0.4ppt). Need top failing endpoints + quick actions. :mag:
maria: Top failing endpoints (60m by 5xx volume): /v1/embeddings/batch, /v1/chat/stream, /v1/generate, /ingest/events. Embeddings batch is the largest contributor (about 48% of 5xx). Sample logs:
```
2026-03-02T08:41:02Z ERROR 504 POST /v1/embeddings/batch job=eb_231 lat=4820ms
2026-03-02T08:42:10Z ERROR 502 POST /v1/chat/stream id=ch_o9 lat=1250ms
2026-03-02T08:43:33Z WARN 429 POST /v1/generate acct=orbitpay token_bucket=0.0
```
sam: Runtime note: embeddings-pool showed sustained queue growth starting ~08:35Z. No deploys in the window. Also saw client-side increase in batch size for this account yesterday.
chris: Proposed immediate actions: 1) throttle max batch to 1024 at edge for OrbitPay, 2) bump embeddings-pool +1 instance, 3) request customer to reduce client-side parallelism. Ops can do (2) now; edge throttle is ~15min.
ops-bot: autoscale-bot: embeddings-pool scaled +1 at 08:50:12Z by ops override.
maria: After +1 instance, embeddings 504s dropped from ~3.6% -> 0.9% over 7min. Overall 5xx down to 1.4%. Timeouts on /ingest/events still elevated, pinging infra.
rachel: Good recovery. Jess/CSM — please ask OrbitPay to pause large parallel batches for 1hr and note we'll apply a short-term throttle. I'll keep renewal risk flag in monitoring until stable for 2h.
maria: Incident INC-20260302-ORBIT created, adding logs and actions. Will keep it open for 2h hold.
